title: Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru. Season 2

thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the story confusing and poorly coherent.
Some felt the central conflict was forced, illogical, or insufficiently motivated.
Character reactions were divided: one character was seen as frustrating and indecisive, while another remained enjoyable despite the writing issues.
A few commenters still found the episode entertaining through its dramatic or humorous moments.

notes: The title explicitly identifies The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 and episode 5. I retrieved the thread page and 10 visible user comments; animation, pacing, and sound were not clearly discussed by several commenters.
